measurement.clock: perf_counter, GNU time launch through blocking wait4 completion, including launcher overhead
measurement.cache: warm filesystem pages; fresh processes; one excluded warmup pair per scenario; semantic samples restore per-executable prepared states
measurement.cpu: wait4 user/system seconds for the command and waited descendants, plus detached inference worker /proc stat deltas at SC_CLK_TCK resolution
measurement.memory: GNU time %M command peak plus detached inference workers' lifetime VmHWM, in KiB; sum of peaks bounds concurrent RSS; worker snapshots and client_resources are separate
measurement.io: Linux wait4 block I/O (512-byte blocks) plus detached inference worker /proc io read_bytes/write_bytes deltas; cached reads are not block input; includes command output and GNU time's resource report
measurement.faults: wait4 minor/major page faults and voluntary/involuntary context switches
measurement.cpu_total_seconds: sum of user and system CPU for each sample
